Issued senior notes via 424B5 shelf — refreshes debt maturity profile
Filed FY2023 10-K: revenue $195.3B baseline post-Express Scripts integration scale

Rebranded operating structure around Evernorth and Cigna Healthcare segments
Early post-merger integration reporting in 10-Q segment disclosures

industry.structure: U.S. health services is concentrated among a handful of integrated insurers and PBMs (UnitedHealth, CVS/Aetna, Cigna/Evernorth, Elevance). Scale drives pharmacy purchasing power and employer RFP wins; regulation (Medicare Advantage, PBM transparency) is the main exogenous pricing lever.
industry.share_shift: Evernorth gains share in specialty pharmacy and care services when employers consolidate vendors; Cigna Healthcare competes on network breadth and Medicare star ratings. Utilization spikes have recently favored PBMs over insurance margin.
industry.trend: Medical-cost trend, Medicare Advantage rate notices, and PBM spread regulation are the live industry variables; integrated models are consolidating admin and pharmacy under one contract.
